{{Quote|Commandos specialize in hitting the enemy as hard as possible. Their training focuses on assault cannons, specialized blaster munitions, and advanced medical probes.|Lieutenant [[Ballard]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Commando advanced training program''' was a training program in the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. [[Republic trooper|Troopers]] who underwent the Commando program specialized in heavy-hitting weaponry such as [[Assault cannon/Legends|assault cannons]], specialized [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weaponry, and medical technology.

==Behind the scenes==
The Commando is an advanced class for the trooper class in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' MMO video game. This advanced class specializes in either powerful weaponry and damage, or healing other players. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] counterpart for this archetype is the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]].
